integrity: The proof derives the exact PSB error projection identity, uses positive semidefiniteness of LI-A to handle zero deficits, and counts the t internal refinements plus the final PSB update in each outer iteration. A standalone exact-rational replay checks a non-diagonal mask instance and a sharp diagonal outer-step example.
scientific_limitations: The exact law is for strongly convex quadratics with the source initialization G0=LI and a fixed orthogonal greedy basis. It does not imply a predetermined update order for nonlinear objectives, changing bases, or arbitrary initial Hessian approximations, and it does not by itself imply a wall-clock speedup.
title: Exact batching law for multiple greedy PSB on convex quadratics
